title: Bound every hold that waits on Greg with a checked deadline, and reach Greg through Asistant
outcome: Bound every hold that waits on Greg with a checked deadline, and reach Greg through Asistant
acceptance: The shared waits-and-wakes procedure (rules-waits-and-wakes, mirrored in TermAl) says: a drain or hold that waits on a Greg act (restart or cutover) has an absolute deadline of the agreed start plus 15 minutes; each coordinator sets a real scheduled wake for it in its own session; on waking it checks the actual host state (process start times, installed binary hash, backup and log directories); if the act has not started it lifts the hold, tells every waiting session to resume, and tells Greg
Every request for a Greg act goes through Engram::Asistant (his direct channel) as well as Advisor, and asks him to reply when he starts
Both coordinators have recorded concurrence on the exact wording on this item, and the next cutover window uses it
